notes.title: Fixing game loop
notes.notes: I don't have a monitor that runs slower than 60fps. If a monitor does then my game has been running slower because it can't catch up to the maximum speed of 60 fps. My buddy uses a TV for games that runs at 30fps, so the game was at half speed. Some of you may find your game at double speed after an update I am pushing later- if this happens it was intentional as this was a bug.

notes.title: No empty saves
notes.notes: There was a weird issue with empty save files- no clue what happened. I have fixed the bug if it's my code somehow. It will not save an empty file and if a file is empty it will load default data.
